candidates.place_reason: 306e audit 2026-10-13: similarity (6 pts, resid 0.0 m, 2.00 m/px, +0.0 deg). The 6 anchors are a perfect 100-px grid ladder (5 distinct points: u 300/400/500 at v 1400, u 400 at v 1300/1500), so the fit carries no placement information at all and the site point inverse-maps to plate px (399.7, 1399.7) = blank paper WEST of the drawn plan. The drawn plan (Basire's schematic, a ring ~780 m across) is centred at plate (620,1490) = 440 m E / 180 m S of the site point, so it renders over the flat farmland SE of the hill ('Old Sarum Farm' / 'Castle Villa' on the 1842 six-inch); the drawn ring misses the real 400-550 m oval (the central moated 'Castle' r~85 m on the site point, the outer bank 175-275 m). Wrong place, right kind of picture (the bury-castle class). Document deleted.

candidates.title: Ancient Plan of Old Sarum
candidates.place_reason: 306e audit 2026-10-13: similarity (6 pts, resid 9.0-40.2 m, 1.29 m/px, +0.2 deg). The 6 anchors are a rough ~350x400-px ladder with ~14% anisotropy, so the residuals measure the ladder's own inconsistency, not a placement miss. The drawn complex (the 'Ichnography' bird's-eye of the concentric ring-castle) is centred ~on the site point (the drawn inner 'Castle Well' circle at 18 E / 31 S, radius ~115 m vs the real moated 'Castle' r~85 m on the site point) but the drawn works are consistently OVERSIZE: the drawn outer ring reaches ~150-175 m on the NW (sitting on the real NW arc) but ~450-480 m on the S/SE (the real S outer edge is 250-275 m), and the drawn S 'Leaving Street' runs ~150 m past the real hill edge out over the flat 'Old Sarum Farm' ground. Goodrich class: centre ~right, drawn works bigger than the real complex, walls past the fields. Document deleted.
